hero.title: Dutch, echt waar.
hero.blurb: Eighteen weeks. Short daily lessons. A buddy who walks you from total beginner to real fluency — through B1, into B2 depth, up to the C1 gateway — in real Netherlands Dutch.

bullets.text: lekker, gezellig, doe maar. Not textbook Dutch.
15 to 35 minutes, sized to fit your day.
your progress saves to this device.

levels.title: A1 Foundations
levels.blurb: Greet, introduce yourself, order coffee, describe your day.

levels.title: A2 Building
levels.blurb: Tell stories in the past. Travel, health, everyday life.

levels.title: B1 Threshold
levels.blurb: Opinions, hypotheticals, real conversations — and staying in Dutch.

levels.title: B2 Depth
levels.blurb: The grammar B1 skips: the full passive, the hypothetical past, formal and written register, complex clauses and indirect speech.

levels.title: C1 Gateway
levels.blurb: Nuance and register agility — layered particles, irony, idioms, and functioning in professional and media Dutch. The leap, honestly framed.
